summary: AGF A/S engages in the sports and facilities business in Denmark. The company is involved in sports-related activities, such as season tickets and TV money, sponsorships, transfers, match management, and physiotherapy; and facilities-related activities, including stall sales, other events, conferences, and concert performances. It also engages in the operation of football teams for men's, women's and youth elite team; merchandise sales; and restaurant and catering activities. The company was formerly known as Aarhus Elite A/S and changed its name to AGF A/S in December 2017. AGF A/S was founded in 1880 and is based in in Viby J, Denmark.
